applicability: Realization claims the curator writer plans for the targets of one admitted hand-off entry.
conditions: A target's own rationale or role is a nonblank string, or the entry states realization_rationale / realization_role as an explicit default.
exclusions: Role words outside the shipped vocabulary, which are refused at admission (L45-S6) rather than stored.
The retired database-era realization site; the obligation is recorded on converted memory only.
statement: Each realization target's own rationale and role win over the entry-level realization_rationale and realization_role, which apply only to what a target leaves unstated; the two halves resolve independently, and a role stated at neither level is stored unclassified.
